subject: Edge Coloring Only Applies to some Edges, and Doesn't Allow Other Data

messages.author: bca2e12f43d6d353
messages.subject: Edge Coloring Only Applies to some Edges, and Doesn't Allow Other Data
parts:
Hi there,

I've been really struggling to color edges on my tree. The tree data is attached as a phylip (output from iqtree), and the supplementary data as a tsv. The script that I'm using is also attached. 

In the script I load the tree data, and root the tree. Then, using the $data dataframe from the tree and the supplementary data, I create a new column of corrected tip labels, filter the nodes with > 85% bootstrap support, and create a column of colors for clades based on their nodes (e.g. nodes >= 120 and <= 139 should be "coral4"). I run into two problems:

1) I want to fill nodes with a point indicating that the nodes have > 85% BS. Adding in the bootstrap data from a different source (e.g. + geom_point(data = high.BS.nodes) after aes(color=I(colored.tree$color)) gives an error that my bootstrap Aesthetics must be length 1 or the same as the data. It works if I do not include the edge coloring aes(). Why is this?

2) If I exclude the bootstrapping points, the coloring still doesn't work. For example, even though nodes 160 and 161 are labelled as "dodgerblue4" they still come up black. I'm not sure why this happens either.

I'm at a loss here and can't figure out why these parts don't work. I'm sure there's a simpler way to do it. Could someone please help?

Thanks,

Alex

Hi again,

Here's simplified code for you, that should be reproducible with the attached dataset (88inds*.treefile). Basically, I can either place dots on nodes (for BS support), or color the edges, but not both. What can I do to fix this?

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(phylobase)
library(ggtree)

# Load the combined data nexus tree file
iqtree <- read.tree("88inds-90p-clean-tree.phylip.treefile")

# Root the tree
iqtree.rooted <- ape::root(iqtree, outgroup = "S46", resolve.root = TRUE)

# Fill the nodes where bootstraps are > 85, without branch lengths. Find the nodes, then label only those nodes.
tree <- ggtree(iqtree.rooted, branch.length = "none")

tree.data <- filter(tree$data, isTip == FALSE)

tree.data$label <- as.numeric(tree.data$label)

bootstraps.morethan85.nobranches <- filter(tree.data, label >= 85)

# Create color data frame
colored.tree <- tree$data

## Assign the colors!!
colored.tree$color  <- rep("black", nrow(colored.tree))

# This is a useful plot to see which nodes to color
ggtree(iqtree.rooted, branch.length = "none")%<+%
  colored.tree +
  geom_text(aes(label=node), hjust=-0.1, size = 3) +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label=correctedname), size =3, hjust=-0.25) +
  xlim(0,23)

# Color the top two clades
colored.tree$color[which(colored.tree$node >= 120 & colored.tree$node <= 139 | colored.tree$node >= 27 & colored.tree$node <= 47)] <- "coral4"

# Plot the black and white tree with BS support on nodes
ggtree(iqtree.rooted, branch.length = "none")%<+%
  colored.tree +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label=correctedname), size = 2.75)+
  geom_point(data = bootstraps.morethan85.nobranches)+
  xlim(0,23)

# Plot tree in color. Does not work with BS supports
ggtree(iqtree.rooted, branch.length = "none")%<+%
  colored.tree +
  aes(color=I(color))+
  geom_tiplab(aes(label=correctedname), size = 2.75)+
  #geom_point(data = bootstraps.morethan85.nobranches)+
  xlim(0,23)
